name: Web Dev Correctness & Debugging (JS)
description: Output-prediction and debugging over original JavaScript snippets, in the CRUXEval output-prediction format. Covers coercion, the event loop and microtask ordering, closures and scope, prototypes, async/promise semantics, and JSON serialization. Every canonical answer is produced by executing the snippet under Node.js, never written by hand. Graded exactly on the final ANSWER line.
